**Daily Devotional**

**February 9**

*17 He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again. (Proverbs 19:17 KJV)*

This verse tells us that the Lord looks at our giving to the poor, as the same as lending to the Lord. What a wonderful thought, that as we help the needy, the Lord is taking note, and as Jesus said, that when we do things for the unfortunate, it is like doing it unto Him (Matthew 25:40). What a great motivation to help the needy, as it is the same as doing it to the Lord. If we give our money, or time, or possessions, to those in need, it is like giving it to Jesus. That makes me want to give everything away to the needy.

This is one of many promises in the Word that tells us that when we give to the needy, or the church, with the motive of love, then God will repay us (Matthew 19:21). It all goes back to the principal of planting a seed, as when you give, it is like planting a seed, and in time you will reap a crop. If you give out of love (2 Corinthians 9:7), of your time, money, or possessions, you are planting a crop, and you will reap in proportion to how much you plant (2 Corinthians 9:6). The whole kingdom of God works on this principal of sowing and reaping, and it seems that most Christians do not understand it. You need to study the Word, and the parable of the man who sowed seed (Matthew 13:3-9), and depending on the ground
